514:t_2:47.en:
$$クロノ隊員$$
「Advance! We'll eliminate anyone who interferes with our mission!」

514:t_2:51.en:
$n
(Why are they so easy to beat...? I can't believe these people have had combat training...)

514:t_2:52.en:
$n
(Do they just rely on their machines' performance in mobile weapon combat too...?)

514:t_2:55.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「...I never imagined we'd meet again here...」

514:t_2:57.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I'm $$コード：ホワイト$$ now... A member of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists' operational unit.」

514:t_2:59.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「We came to purge $$プラント$$ for cooperating with the Empire, despite being descendants of the Reformists.」

514:t_2:60.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Though it seems you've defeated the team meant to assassinate their leaders.」

514:t_2:61.en:
$n
「...Please tell me. Why are you in $$クロノ$$, $$マキ#pilot$$...?」

514:t_2:62.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I joined around April of last year... They recruited me, saying I had potential.」

514:t_2:64.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「That's right. I joined $$クロノ$$ to change the world.」

514:t_2:65.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Though I never imagined I'd end up fighting you...」

514:t_2:66.en:
$n
「Was what you told me on $$翠の地球$$ a lie!?」

514:t_2:67.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「A lie...? I never told any lies.」

514:t_2:68.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I am both the nurse $$柏葉真紀$$ and $$コード：ホワイト$$ of $$クロノ$$, after all.」

514:t_2:69.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Unless the Captain gave me orders, I was just a nurse working in Japan.」

514:t_2:70.en:
$n
「What does changing the world mean!? Is it related to watching over humanity's evolution, as the Reformists say!?」

514:t_2:71.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「You don't need to know that. We simply follow Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s orders.」

514:t_2:72.en:
$n
「That's...! You joined $$クロノ$$ without even knowing what it does!?」

514:t_2:75.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「The Captain deserves our trust... Isn't that enough?」

514:t_2:77.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「This is a good opportunity, $n. I'll forgive you for raising your sword against the Captain.」

514:t_2:78.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「So come with me. I'm sure the Captain will welcome you if you apologize.」

514:t_2:80.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Let's go, $n. ...Or won't you listen to my request?」

514:t_2:83.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「The Captain and I could shelter you in our arms too.」

514:t_2:86.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Why won't you listen to the Captain's words...?」

514:t_3:3.en: ～$$プラント$$ Defense Committee Chairman's　Office～

514:t_3:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「You're awfully calm. Did you know we were coming?」

514:t_3:8.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「...I was simply prepared for the day I would face you like this.」

514:t_3:9.en:
$$シン$$
「Then you know why we came here too!」

514:t_3:10.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Whatever you say, you can't stop me.」

514:t_3:11.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「I'll... carry on $$ギル$$'s will and complete the $$デスティニープラン$$.」

514:t_3:13.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's... why you joined forces with $$フロンタル$$.」

514:t_3:14.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「At least that man agrees with my plan.」

514:t_3:15.en:
$$シン$$
「Why, $$レイ#pt136$$!? We rejected the Chairman's plan during the $$多元戦争$$!」

514:t_3:16.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「The $$デスティニープラン$$... A system where society presents each person with the ideal life based on their genetic information...」

514:t_3:17.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Neither you nor $$フロンタル$$ know its true meaning.」

514:t_3:18.en:
$$キラ$$
「You mean the true meaning of the $$デスティニープラン$$...?」

514:t_3:19.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Yes... After leaving $$ザフト$$, I spent my recovery reading every document $$ギル$$ left behind.」

514:t_3:20.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「I read not only documents related to his public duties, but his private ones too.」

514:t_3:21.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Then I met $$フル・フロンタル$$, whose circumstances were much like mine.」

514:t_3:22.en:
$$シン$$
「What do you mean, similar circumstances...?」

514:t_3:23.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ is a clone of $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

514:t_3:25.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Our meeting was no coincidence. $$フロンタル$$ probably approached me for his own purposes.」

514:t_3:26.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「But that suited me too, as I sought to carry on $$ギル$$'s aspirations.」

514:t_3:27.en:
$$シン$$
「What is it!? What the Chairman was trying to do... The true meaning of the $$デスティニープラン$$!」

514:t_3:29.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「The true meaning of the $$デスティニープラン$$... It is a plan to open the way to humanity's future...」

514:t_3:30.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「It is meant to find humans awakened to a new power, and protect them from $$クロノ$$.」

514:t_3:32.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Yes. $$ギル$$ sought to fulfill his mission as a $$クロノ$$ Reformist through a means other than $$コーディネイター$$s.」

514:t_3:33.en:
$$シン$$
「What do you mean, humans awakened to a new power!? Something like $$ニュータイプ$$s or $$イノベイター$$s!?」

514:t_3:34.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Don't you understand, $$シン$$? I mean you, $$キラ・ヤマト$$, $$アスラン・ザラ$$, and the others.」

514:t_3:35.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm... a new kind of human...」

514:t_3:36.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「Didn't you find it strange that $$ギル$$, Chairman of the $$プラント$$ Supreme Council, paid special attention to you...?」

514:t_3:37.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「And that he kept such a close watch on $$キラ$$'s movements and tried to bring him into contact with you?」

514:t_3:39.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「It seems that was also to draw out the potential sleeping within you.」
